text:
Hi! So this was a worry for me as well. My kids are not Jewish as I am not Jewish. They have not experienced any exclusion whatsoever. Both of my girls are in a secular, Jewish kindergarten and primary school.

At some point in time, I will tell them that they’re not Jewish and if they wish to convert, they would be able to do so in the army… but the way I see it I hope they will be surrounded by people who accept them the way they are, also regarding future partners for them.
